professionalSummary.text: Seasoned Shift Operations Supervisor with four years managing three high‑speed bottling lines, consistently allocating crews, leading briefings, resolving stoppages, and maintaining accurate shift records.
professionalSummary.witness: Shift operations supervisor at a bottling plant with three high-speed lines for four years, allocating a crew of seventeen across the lines each shift under the plant's crewing plan.

experienceHighlights.text: Allocated a crew of seventeen across three lines each shift in accordance with the plant's crewing plan.
experienceHighlights.witness: allocating a crew of seventeen across the lines each shift under the plant's crewing plan.

experienceHighlights.text: Conducted shift start and hand‑over briefings within the five‑minute standard, covering line allocation, safety notices, changeover time, and targets.
experienceHighlights.witness: asked to run a shift-start briefing for the panel, the candidate covered the line allocation, the two safety notices, the changeover time and the target for each line in that order, asked each crew lead by name to confirm their allocation, and finished inside the five minutes the standard allows.

experienceHighlights.text: Resolved line stoppages collaboratively with maintenance technicians, logging each incident and resolution in the line system.
experienceHighlights.witness: Resolved the line stoppages with the shift maintenance technician under the stoppage procedure, with each stoppage and its resolution logged in the line system.

experienceHighlights.text: Recorded shift output and downtime in the line system, noting that line speed and changeover decisions were made by the production manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: Recorded the shift's output and downtime in the line system each shift; line speed and changeover decisions were the production manager's, recorded against my shift record.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented open items and hand‑over conditions on the hand‑over sheet for the next supervisor.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the shift's open items and hand-over conditions on the hand-over sheet for the next supervisor.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided a one‑week set of briefing records, stoppage logs, and hand‑over sheets with line system references as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one week's briefing records with the crew leads' signatures, the stoppage log for the same week and one hand-over sheet, with the line system references as a verification trail.
